description: Comprehensive prompt to fix all 20 infrastructure issues identified in the shake test

issues.title: Hardcoded Test API Keys in Production Config
issues.problem: Test keys bundled into production builds prevent real purchases

solution.approach: Use EAS Secrets and environment variables instead of hardcoding
steps: Configure EAS secrets: eas secret:create --name EXPO_PUBLIC_REVENUECAT_IOS_KEY --value <prod_key>
Update app.json to use dynamic config via app.config.js

issues.title: No Session Token Authentication
issues.problem: Client-provided userId is trusted without server-side session validation

solution.approach: Implement JWT-based session tokens with server-side validation
steps: Add session token generation on sign-in
Store session tokens in database with expiry
Validate session token on every authenticated request

issues.title: Unprotected Admin Mutation - seedAdmin
issues.problem: seedAdmin mutation can be called by anyone to grant themselves admin access

solution.approach: Convert to internalMutation and add environment check

issues.title: Unprotected Password Reset Mutation - resetUserPassword
issues.problem: Anyone can reset any user's password without authorization

solution.approach: Convert to internalMutation with admin verification

issues.title: No Rate Limiting Anywhere
issues.problem: No rate limiting on auth endpoints enables brute force attacks and email bombing

solution.approach: Implement rate limiting using a rateLimits table

issues.title: Weak Password Reset Token
issues.problem: Only 6 chars using non-cryptographic Math.random()

solution.approach: Use crypto.getRandomValues() with longer token and add attempt limiting

issues.title: Missing Input Validation
issues.problem: No validation on email format, password strength, string lengths

solution.approach: Add validation helpers and apply to all mutations

issues.title: Demo Trial Bypass
issues.problem: Users can repeatedly activate demo trials

solution.approach: Track trial usage per user and prevent reactivation

issues.title: Scalability Issue - listBooks Query
issues.problem: Loads ALL books into memory, then filters client-side

solution.approach: Use proper Convex indexes for filtering and pagination

issues.title: N+1 Query Pattern
issues.problem: Each item triggers a separate database query for related data

solution.approach: Batch lookups using Promise.all with deduplication

issues.title: Insecure Admin Auth Store
issues.problem: Admin role stored in localStorage can be modified by attacker

solution.approach: Always verify role server-side, use localStorage only for session token

issues.title: Duplicate Data Structure (Stories vs Books)
issues.problem: Legacy stories table alongside books table causes confusion

solution.approach: Add type discriminator and plan migration
migration_plan: 3. Update all favorites queries to filter by contentType
5. Update favorites contentType for migrated content
7. After validation period, remove stories table

issues.title: Missing Error Boundaries and Retry Logic
issues.problem: No retry mechanism for transient failures

solution.approach: Add retry logic with exponential backoff

issues.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
issues.problem: All deployments are manual, no automated testing

solution.approach: Set up GitHub Actions for automated testing and deployment

github_actions_workflow.content:
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      
      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm --filter admin exec tsc --noEmit
      
      - name: Lint
        run: pnpm --filter admin exec eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx
      
      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

  deploy-convex:
    needs: lint-and-test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8
      
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      
      - name: Deploy Convex
        run: npx convex deploy
        env:
          CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY }}

  deploy-admin:
    needs: lint-and-test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Deploy to Vercel
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v25
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          vercel-args: '--prod'
